name: Pinata donkey
summary: Colourful paper pinata shaped as a stylised donkey, with fringed crepe-paper stripes, hanging from a rope. Anim swing.

params.name: y
params.note: y of the rope's top (where it is tied); the donkey hangs about 400 px below

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the donkey is about 560 px wide and 580 px tall with the rope

params.name: color
params.note: head colour; the body stripes are other bright colours

params.name: anim
params.note: swing = the piñata swings gently from the rope

author: krakujs
